title: Inheritance and Parish
author: Beatrix Amberdale
blurb: Isandro Reyes, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the trial begins.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
